summary: Change the backup destination from ./backups with backup_dir and exclude duplicated hub data with hub_data_path_exclude, set in the inventory, with -e or in an extra vars file for ansible.containerized_installer.backup.
questions: How do I change the containerized AAP backup directory?
How do I exclude snapshots from the hub backup?
What playbook backs up containerized AAP?

answer_card.title: Back up containerized AAP
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-playbook -i inventory ansible.containerized_installer.backup \
  -e hub_data_path_exclude="['*/.snapshots', '*/.snapshots/*']"
```
- Default destination `./backups`; change with `backup_dir`
- Use the installer that matches the installed version
